ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in circle $O$, with $\overset{\frown}{AD} = \overset{\frown}{CD}$, $\angle ABD = 33^\circ$, and $\angle ACB = 44^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle BAD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $\overset{\frown}{CD}=\overset{\frown}{CD}$,\\
$\therefore \angle DAC=\angle DBC=33^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAD=\angle DAC+\angle CAB=33^\circ+70^\circ=\boxed{103^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: From the image, note the cyclic order of the points around the circle is A-D-C-B, and the requested angle ∠BAD is split by chord AC into ∠BAC + ∠CAD. From the text, use ∠ABD = 33°, ∠ACB = 44°, and arc AD = arc CD. Apply the inscribed angle theorem: ∠ABD intercepts arc AD, so arc AD = 66°. Hence arc CD = 66°, so ∠CAD, which intercepts arc CD, is 33°. Also ∠ACB intercepts arc AB, so arc AB = 88°. Since the arcs around the circle sum to 360°, arc BC = 360° - 66° - 66° - 88° = 140°, so ∠BAC = 70°. Therefore ∠BAD = ∠BAC + ∠CAD = 70° + 33° = 103°.

因此 ∠BAD = ∠BAC + ∠CAD = 70° + 33° = 103°。
